name: VERNAL -- ILLEGAL DUMPING
incident_summary: Price Pumping in Vernal handles various forms of liquid waste: human waste and the liquid waste from the oil drilling and operation processes like drilling mud and tank bottoms. Price Pumping has constructed an unpermitted pond behind their shop and is dumping solid and liquid waste. Nathan Hall met with a Price Pumping representative, and walked the site with them. Price Pumping claims that the recent earthwork shown in the pictures was in connection with getting a stormwater approval from Vernal City for a new building and they plan to construct a "stormwater pond" in the location of the reported unpermitted disposal pond. It appeared that the pond used to be a lot bigger and Price Pumping has pushed dirt up to make it smaller. There was a gray colored residue in the pond that appeared to have been there for a while and had dried out. Next to the pond there was also a recently dumped load of what looked like clay or hydrated bentonite that was still muddy and wet, probably dumped in the last few days. Price Pumping has had enforcement action in the past. In 2017 TriCounty issued a legal order requiring them to clean up some solid waste they had dumped on the ground behind their shop and followed through to ensure they cleaned it up. Nathan Hall visited the site on April 23, 2024 and took the pictures which are attached
